verdict.rationale: Undermind's own docs say users can 'Get notified whenever relevant papers are published,' and the enterprise tier describes alerts that monitor saved topics and send updates. That covers a recurring standing search that surfaces new sources, not just a one-off search. Both claims are brief marketing lines, though. Missing for 10: details on how alerts are set up and how often they run, the delivery channels, any limits per plan, and independent or hands-on confirmation that alerts work.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can set up standing searches or alerts that surface new relevant sources as they appear

citations.quote: Get notified whenever relevant papers are published.
Role-aware alerts: Monitors saved topics and sends concise updates tailored to each teammate’s role and active projects.
